text: Sky Nine is live above the eastbound ring road, where police are pursuing a suspect vehicle.
We're told the driver has refused to stop for officers.
And there it is. The suspect vehicle.
Travelling at speeds approaching twenty-two miles per hour.
The driver is showing no signs of panic whatsoever.
He has indicated. Correctly. At every junction so far.
Police have now committed six vehicles to the operation.
Wait. Wait, he's making his move!
He has stopped. A tense standoff at the junction of Wexley Road.
He is indicating left. He is parking.
The suspect has exited the vehicle. He is carrying what appears to be a sandwich.
We may have been covering a man's drive home.
Sky Nine. Back to the studio.
